_comment: #594 — documented SAFE drifts between the native prover's miden-client pin
version behind the wallet's @miden-sdk/miden-sdk. Enforced by
A drift is safe ONLY when no transaction-kernel crate moved between the two
versions: miden-protocol, miden-tx, miden-core-lib, miden-assembly, miden-core,
miden-mast-package, miden-prover. A miden-client(-web/-store)-only bump keeps
the same procedure set, so the pinned prover still produces matching MAST
procedure roots. Verify by diffing the two web-sdk tags' Cargo.lock.
Prefer bumping the pin AND rebuilding the committed prover binaries. Add an
exemption only when the rebuild is deferred and the drift is verified safe by
the argument above; remove the entry once the pin is bumped.
Each entry is keyed on (pin, sdkVersion), so it auto-expires on ANY
@miden-sdk/miden-sdk bump — an immutable tag's Cargo.lock can float a kernel
crate under a fixed miden-client version, so keying on miden-client alone
would let that drift through. sdkMidenClient is the client version that
sdkVersion's Cargo.lock is expected to resolve; a mismatch fails as stale.

exemptions.reason: web-sdk 0.15.9 bumped miden-client 0.15.4->0.15.5 (and miden-client-web/-sqlite-store/-idxdb-store) only; every transaction-kernel crate (miden-protocol/tx/core-lib/assembly/core/mast-package/prover) is unchanged, so the =0.15.4 prover produces the same procedure set as SDK 0.15.9. Verified by diffing the web-sdk 0.15.8/0.15.9 Cargo.lock in #594.
